clusters.text: Summer events generally occur at high demand, occurring without specific causes, indicative of overall shortfall of supply (aligned to supply demand balance for the outer years).
Shoulder events occur at moderate demand levels due to increased Outages, generally due to higher planned Outages in shoulder seasons.
Winter events at higher demand levels are dominated by reduced renewables availability.
Events in winter also occur at low demand, where low renewables combined with low SOC result in USE even at low demand.
